resources.string: Transfer notes to Pampa Notes on another device or share them with someone.

Includes notes, folders, tags, every raw and refined version, the selected version, available audio, originals and images, speakers, dates, and existing segment and word timings. Untimed versions remain untimed.

One losslessly compressed .pn file: audio keeps the same bytes. Before writing, I also look for missing attachments in available cloud transfers, without needing a PC. Unrecoverable attachments are reported.
Approximate size before compression and deduplication: %1$s
Looking for files on this device, in cloud transfers that are still valid, or on your home computer. You can cancel retrieval.
You can cancel and resend the files from the device that keeps them, or retry with your computer on. “Export without” reports missing attachments in the result; a .pn file also keeps their metadata.
